description: Machine-readable inventory of all Dataverse Environment Variables the demo solution defines. Authoritative source per Topic 4. Consumed by install.ps1 (prompt for missing required), upgrade.ps1 (detect deltas), doctor.ps1 (validate format + presence), and the Tier-1 schema-drift validator.

categories.name: Url
categories.description: URLs of provisioned resources. Must be https; must not contain localhost or 127.0.0.1 (locked runtime independence).

categories.name: Id
categories.description: GUIDs / IDs of provisioned resources (Teams team/channel, SharePoint library, Entra app reg, Copilot Studio agent).

categories.name: Secret
categories.description: Secret references via the SecretRef abstraction (Topic 4): plain:<value> or kv:<keyVault>/<secret>[?version=<v>]. Doctor warns on plain:* mode in info-level findings.

categories.name: Tunable
categories.description: Demo behavior tunables (cron strings, intervals, MDR clock duration). Per-env overridable.

categories.name: Feature
categories.description: Per-vignette / per-feature boolean flags. All ON by default at install (Topic 4).

categories.name: Brand
categories.description: Brand strings surfaced in UI footer / agent salutation / Demo Mode banner.

variables.name: cch_UrlSharePointSite
variables.description: SharePoint site holding the Continuum Knowledge library and weekly republished grounding docs.

variables.name: cch_UrlPagesSite
variables.description: The deployed Power Pages site URL (V1 + V2 surfaces).
readBy: Patient Support agent V1 deep links

variables.name: cch_UrlCodeApp
variables.description: The deployed Power Apps Code App URL (V3, V4, V5 surfaces).
readBy: Quality Triage 'Open in Quality Workspace' deep link

variables.name: cch_UrlTeamsTenant
variables.description: Base URL for composing Teams deep links.

variables.name: cch_UrlGraphBase
variables.description: Microsoft Graph base URL used by Teams channel-post flow.

variables.name: cch_IdTeamsTeam
variables.description: GUID of the Teams team containing the demo channels (Quality, Field, Enablement, Leadership).

variables.name: cch_IdTeamsChannelQuality
variables.description: Quality Triage Teams channel — receives V4 triage cards.

variables.name: cch_IdTeamsChannelLeadership
variables.description: Leadership Teams channel — receives V4 escalation cards.

variables.name: cch_IdTeamsChannelField
variables.description: Field team Teams channel — receives V3 FCS channel updates.

variables.name: cch_IdTeamsChannelEnablement
variables.description: Enablement Teams channel — receives V5/V6 enablement-tool result cards (sample orders, training schedules).

variables.name: cch_IdSharePointLibraryKnowledge
variables.description: SharePoint library 'Continuum Knowledge' GUID — agents ground on subfolders inside.

variables.name: cch_IdAgentPatientSupport
variables.description: Patient Support agent ID (used for V1 floating bubble + V2 dashboard panel + V3 docked panel).

variables.name: cch_IdAgentQualityTriage
variables.description: Quality Triage agent ID (V4 triggered by cch_TriggerQualityTriage flow + V4 docked analyst chat).

variables.name: cch_IdAgentEnablement
variables.description: Continuum Enablement agent ID (V5 Knowledge tab + V6 multi-surface).

variables.name: cch_IdEntraAppPagesAuth
variables.description: Entra app registration for Power Pages identity provider.

variables.name: cch_IdEntraAppServicePrincipal
variables.description: Entra app registration for the service principal used by flows + agent tools (Topic 3 ServicePrincipal Dataverse role).
readBy: Documentation only; not read by flows at runtime

variables.name: cch_IdPipelinesHostEnv
variables.description: Power Platform Pipelines host environment ID. Set after Provision-Pipelines.ps1 runs.

variables.name: cch_SecretDirectLinePatientSupport
variables.description: Direct Line secret for Patient Support agent. Stored as plain:<value> or kv:<vault>/<secret>.

variables.name: cch_SecretDirectLineQualityTriage
variables.description: Direct Line secret for Quality Triage agent.

variables.name: cch_SecretDirectLineEnablement
variables.description: Direct Line secret for Continuum Enablement agent.

variables.name: cch_SecretGraphAppClient
variables.description: App client secret for Microsoft Graph access (Teams channel posts via SP+Graph).

variables.name: cch_SecretSPClient
variables.description: Service principal client secret (used for Connection Reference setup, not at flow runtime).

variables.name: cch_TunableLiveSimCron
variables.description: Cron expression for the live-events simulator (default: every 10 min, Mon-Fri, 8 AM-6 PM in cch_TunableTimezone).

variables.name: cch_TunableDemoRefreshCron
variables.description: Cron expression for the daily demo-data refresh flow (default: 5 AM Eastern).

variables.name: cch_TunableMdrClockHours
variables.description: Hours remaining on the MDR clock for the V4 hero complaint after each daily refresh (always tense, never expired).

variables.name: cch_TunableShipmentStepSeconds
variables.description: Seconds between Shipment lifecycle stage transitions (compressed-time so audience visibly sees status change during demo).

variables.name: cch_TunableTimezone
variables.description: Windows timezone id used by all scheduled flows + UI date rendering (Topic 7 lock).

variables.name: cch_DeploymentVersion
variables.description: Current deployed solution version (semver). Stamped by numbered migrations in solutions/ContinuumHealthDemo/migrations/ as they run. Used by upgrade.ps1 to detect which migrations have already executed (handoff section 3.15 lifecycle / migration framework).

variables.name: cch_FeatureV1PatientPortal
variables.description: When false: Pages V1 nav hidden, registration form disabled.

variables.name: cch_FeatureV2HCPPortal
variables.description: When false: Pages V2 auth area hidden.

variables.name: cch_FeatureV3FieldCompanion
variables.description: When false: Code App 'My Day' / Account 360 hidden.

variables.name: cch_FeatureV4QualityTriage
variables.description: When false: Quality nav hidden in Code App; cch_TriggerQualityTriage disabled.

variables.name: cch_FeatureV5EnablementKnowledge
variables.description: When false: Knowledge tab hidden.

variables.name: cch_FeatureV6ExtendEverywhere
variables.description: When false: Teams app + SP webpart + M365 publish skipped at install.

variables.name: cch_FeatureLiveSim
variables.description: When false: live-sim flow paused regardless of cch_LiveSimSetting singleton.

variables.name: cch_FeatureDailyRefresh
variables.description: When false: daily refresh flow paused.

variables.name: cch_FeatureDemoModeBanner
variables.description: Escape hatch only. When false: <DemoModeBanner/> returns null. Locked-on for actual demos (Topic 2).

variables.name: cch_BrandCompanyName
variables.description: Company name in UI footer + agent salutations + grounding docs.

variables.name: cch_BrandPrimaryColor
variables.description: Brand primary teal (locked Topic 2).
readBy: Fluent UI v9 brand ramp in theme.ts
